newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen climbing on Wall Street record.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen climbing on Wall Street record.

text.p: Danish share prices were expected to climb at least one percent on Tuesday in the wake of Wall Street's record close and the strong dollar in a quietish market suffering from a dearth of sellers, dealers said.

"We are looking forward to a good market, even if selling activity could be somewhat restrained. The dollar looks good, bonds seem alright, so we should follow the U.S. up with rises of at least one percent," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.15 point to 157.78 at 0710 gmt, having closed 0.78 point higher on Monday.
